fn comb(n: Int, k: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  requires (k >= 0)
  requires (0 <= k)
  requires (k <= n)
  ensures (result == (if ((k == 0) or (k == n)) then 1 else (comb((n - 1), k) + comb((n - 1), (k - 1)))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (comb(0, 0) == 1)
